title: Shops and shopping
about: Names of shops, the floors and departments of a big store, signs you see in shops, and what people say when they buy and pay for things.

items.pattern: the butcher's (shop) · a butcher (person) · at / to the butcher's
items.meaning: a shop that sells meat
items.example: Mum buys chicken and sausages at the **butcher's** near our school.
more: The **butcher** cut the meat into small pieces for us.
Is the **butcher's** open on Sundays?
items.watchOut: Про магазин часто кажуть з 's: the butcher's (тобто the butcher's shop). Людина — a butcher (м'ясник). Так само the baker's, the chemist's, the newsagent's.

items.pattern: the post office · at / to the post office
items.meaning: a place where you send letters and parcels and buy stamps
items.example: The **post office** is next to the bank.
more: You can buy stamps at the **post office**.
Grandma goes to the **post office** every Monday.
items.watchOut: Пошта як місце — the post office. The post (UK) або the mail (US) — це листи, які приходять: Has the post come yet?

items.pattern: the supermarket · at the supermarket
items.meaning: a very big shop that sells food, drinks and things for the home
items.example: The **supermarket** near my house is open until ten at night.
more: Dad got milk, eggs and apples at the **supermarket**.
Can I push the trolley at the **supermarket**, Mum?
items.watchOut: Наголос на першому складі: SU-per-mar-ket, а не як в українському «супермаркЕт».

items.pattern: a bookshop · at / in the bookshop
items.meaning: a shop that sells books
items.example: I spent my birthday money at the **bookshop**.
more: This **bookshop** has a big section for children.
Let's meet outside the **bookshop** at three.
items.watchOut: Книгарня — bookshop (в американській англійській bookstore). Не плутай з library — бібліотекою, де книжки беруть почитати.

items.pattern: the baker's (shop) · a baker (person) · a bakery
items.meaning: a shop that sells bread and cakes
items.example: The **baker's** on our street sells fresh bread every morning.
more: The **baker's** always smells of warm bread.
The **baker** starts work at four in the morning.
items.watchOut: Магазин — the baker's, людина — a baker (пекар). Слово bakery (пекарня) теж часто кажуть.

items.pattern: a department store · in a department store
items.meaning: a very big shop with many floors that sells lots of different things
items.example: We bought a new sofa and some school shoes in the same **department store**.
more: The **department store** in the city centre has six floors.
My aunt works in a big **department store** in London.
items.watchOut: Універмаг — department store. Department окремо — це відділ усередині магазину: the shoe department.

items.pattern: the chemist's (shop) · a chemist (person)
items.meaning: a shop that sells medicine and things like soap and toothpaste
items.example: I've got a headache. Can you get me some tablets from the **chemist's**?
more: You can buy toothpaste and soap at the **chemist's**.
The **chemist** told me to take the medicine after meals.
items.watchOut: Аптека у Британії — the chemist's або pharmacy, в Америці — drugstore. Chemist означає і «хімік», але в магазині це фармацевт.

items.pattern: the newsagent's (shop) · a newsagent (person)
items.meaning: a small shop that sells newspapers, magazines and sweets
items.example: My brother buys his football magazine at the **newsagent's** every Friday.
more: The **newsagent's** at the station sells drinks too.
Our **newsagent** knows everyone in the street.
items.watchOut: Британське слово. Наголос на першому складі: NEWS-agent.

items.pattern: a gift shop · the museum / zoo gift shop
items.meaning: a shop that sells presents and souvenirs
items.example: In the museum **gift shop** I bought a pencil with a dinosaur on it.
more: The **gift shop** at the airport sells T-shirts and mugs.
I found a nice cup for Mum in a little **gift shop**.
items.watchOut: Gift і present — обидва «подарунок», але крамниця — gift shop, не present shop.

items.pattern: on the ground floor
items.meaning: the floor of a building at the same level as the street
items.example: The supermarket is on the **ground floor** of our building.
more: The toilets are on the **ground floor**.
You can buy a coffee on the **ground floor**.
items.watchOut: У Британії поверх на рівні вулиці — the ground floor (наш перший). First floor — це вже наш другий поверх. В американській англійській first floor — як у нас.

items.pattern: on the first / second / third / fourth floor
items.meaning: in Britain, the floor just above the ground floor
items.example: My bedroom is on the **first floor**, above the kitchen.
more: My classroom is on the **second floor**.
The café is on the **fourth floor**, at the top of the store.
items.watchOut: Поверх — floor, з прийменником on: on the first floor (не in / at). Британський first floor = наш другий поверх, second floor = наш третій.

items.pattern: in the basement
items.meaning: the floor under the ground floor
items.example: Our bikes are in the **basement** of our block of flats.
more: The kitchen things are downstairs in the **basement**.
The food hall is in the **basement** of the store.
items.watchOut: Кажуть in the basement (не on the basement).

items.pattern: some furniture · a piece of furniture
items.meaning: beds, tables, chairs, sofas and cupboards
items.example: Dad made all the **furniture** in our garden himself.
more: Please don't play ball near the **furniture**.
This old chair is my favourite piece of **furniture**.
items.watchOut: Furniture — незлічуване: some furniture, a piece of furniture. Не furnitures і не a furniture, хоча «меблі» в українській — множина.

items.pattern: in men's wear / women's wear · also menswear / womenswear
items.meaning: clothes for men / clothes for women (a part of a big shop)
items.example: Dad went to **men's wear** to look for a new jacket.
more: **Women's wear** is on the first floor.
Excuse me, where's **men's wear**?
items.watchOut: Так підписують відділи в магазині. Пишуть і разом: menswear, womenswear. У розмові частіше кажуть men's clothes / women's clothes.

items.pattern: the children's department · in the children's department
items.meaning: the part of a big shop that sells clothes and things for children
items.example: My little sister found a cute T-shirt in the **children's department**.
more: There's a small play area in the **children's department**.
The **children's department** is next to the toys.
items.watchOut: Children — уже множина, тому просто 's: children's (не childrens і не childrens').

items.pattern: the beauty department · beauty products
items.meaning: the part of a shop that sells make-up, face cream and perfume
items.example: The **beauty** department smells of perfume.
more: **Beauty products** like face cream and lipstick are near the main door.
My aunt sells **beauty products** at the market.
items.watchOut: Beauty products — косметика. Слово cosmetics теж є, але у великих магазинах відділ зазвичай називається Beauty.

items.pattern: in electricals · electrical goods
items.meaning: TVs, fridges, kettles and other things that use electricity
items.example: Kettles and toasters are in **electricals**, downstairs.
more: Is **electricals** in the basement?
You can buy a new hair dryer in **electricals**.
items.watchOut: Electricals — британська назва відділу техніки, завжди з -s. У розмові кажуть також electrical goods.

items.pattern: toys · the toy department · a toy shop
items.meaning: things that children play with
items.example: The **toy department** is on the top floor, next to the café.
more: My little brother always wants to look at the **toys**.
We bought a board game in the **toy shop**.
items.watchOut: Перед іншим іменником — toy без -s: a toy shop, the toy department (не toys shop).

items.pattern: be open · open from … to / until …
items.meaning: you can go in and buy things now
items.example: The café is **open** every day from eight.
more: Is the swimming pool **open** on Sundays?
The park is **open** until it gets dark.
items.watchOut: Магазин відчинений — is open (прикметник). Opened — це дія: She opened the door. Тому не «The shop is opened».

items.pattern: be closed · closed on Mondays
items.meaning: you cannot go in now; it is not working
items.example: We came too late. The shop was **closed**.
more: Sorry, the kitchen is **closed**. You can't order food now.
All the shops were **closed** because it was a holiday.
items.watchOut: Зачинено — closed, з -d. Close без -d тут означає «близько»: The shop is close to my house.

items.pattern: at the cash desk · pay at the cash desk
items.meaning: the place in a shop where you pay
items.example: The **cash desk** is next to the door.
more: Where's the **cash desk**? I want to pay for this book.
Please pay at the **cash desk** on the ground floor.
items.watchOut: Каса — cash desk. У супермаркеті частіше кажуть checkout, а касовий апарат — till. Не kassa.

items.pattern: push the door · PUSH (sign)
items.meaning: move something away from you
items.example: **Push** the door hard. It's a bit heavy.
more: Can you **push** the shopping trolley for me?
Little kids love to **push** the button in the lift.
items.watchOut: На дверях PUSH — «від себе», PULL — «до себе». Їх легко сплутати: push — штовхати, pull — тягнути.

items.pattern: pull the door · PULL (sign)
items.meaning: move something towards you
items.example: The sign on the door says **PULL**.
more: She **pulled** the heavy door and walked in.
**Pull** your chair closer to the table.

items.pattern: an information desk · ask at information · some information
items.meaning: the place where you can ask questions (the sign with the letter i)
items.example: The **information** desk is next to the lifts.
more: We got a map of the store from **information**.
I need some **information** about the bus times.
items.watchOut: Information — незлічуване: some information. Не informations і не an information.

items.pattern: a shop assistant · also sales assistant
items.meaning: a person who works in a shop and helps people buy things
items.example: The **shop assistant** helped me find shoes in my size.
more: The **shop assistant** wrapped the present for me.
My sister works as a **shop assistant** on Saturdays.
items.watchOut: Продавець у магазині — shop assistant. Seller зазвичай кажуть про того, хто продає щось своє (наприклад, свою машину), а не про працівника магазину.

items.pattern: a customer · customers
items.meaning: a person who buys things in a shop
items.example: This café has lots of happy **customers**.
more: We were the first **customers** in the new shop.
A good shop is kind to its **customers**.
items.watchOut: Покупець у магазині — customer. Buyer частіше кажуть про того, хто купує щось велике: будинок, машину.

items.pattern: Can I help you? — Yes, please. / No, thanks. I'm just looking.
items.meaning: what a shop assistant says when they want to help you
items.example: '**Can I help you?**' 'No, thanks. I'm just looking.'
more: The shop assistant smiled and said, '**Can I help you?**'
'**Can I help you?**' 'Yes, I'm looking for a birthday card.'
items.watchOut: Якщо допомога не потрібна, відповідають: No, thanks. I'm just looking. («Дякую, я просто дивлюся»).

items.pattern: try on a dress · try it / them on
items.meaning: put on clothes in a shop to see if they are good for you
items.example: I'd like to **try on** this dress. Where's the changing room?
more: Can I **try on** this hat?
He **tried** the jacket **on**, but it was too small.
items.watchOut: З it / them слово стоїть посередині: try it on, try them on (не try on it).

items.pattern: Have you got a bigger / smaller size? · What size are you?
items.meaning: clothes or shoes that are a bit bigger or smaller
items.example: This T-shirt is too small. Have you got a **bigger size**?
more: These boots are too big. I need a **smaller size**.
What **size** are you? Medium or large?
items.watchOut: Більший розмір — a bigger size, не a more big size. «Який у тебе розмір?» — What size are you?

items.pattern: in a different colour · Have you got it in a different colour?
items.meaning: not the same colour
items.example: Have you got this jumper in a **different colour**? I don't like grey.
more: Let's paint my room a **different colour**.
Each team in the game wears a **different colour**.
items.watchOut: Британське написання — colour (американське — color). «В іншому кольорі» — in a different colour, з in.

items.pattern: I'll take it / them
items.meaning: I want to buy it
items.example: It's perfect. **I'll take it**.
more: The lamp was cheap, so I said, '**I'll take it**.'
These trainers are great. **I'll take them**.
items.watchOut: Коли вирішуєш купити, кажуть I'll take it (з will: рішення зараз). Просто I take it тут звучить неправильно.

items.pattern: How much does it cost? · It costs £5. · cost – cost – cost
items.meaning: have a price
items.example: My new trainers **cost** £40.
more: Tickets for the zoo **cost** £12.
How much does this backpack **cost**?
items.watchOut: Питання — How much does it cost? (з does), відповідь — It costs £5 (з -s). Минулий час теж cost, не costed. Простіше: How much is it?

items.pattern: pay for sth · pay by card / cheque · pay (in) cash · pay – paid – paid
items.meaning: give money for something you buy
items.example: Can I **pay** by card here?
more: Grandma always **pays** for our ice creams.
You **pay** at the desk by the door.
items.watchOut: Платити за щось — pay for sth. Карткою — by card (або with a card), готівкою — in cash або просто cash. Минулий час — paid, не payed.

items.pattern: pay by cheque · write a cheque
items.meaning: a printed paper from your bank: you write how much money and sign it to pay
items.example: Grandad sometimes pays his bills by **cheque**.
more: Not many shops take **cheques** now.
Write the date at the top of the **cheque**.
items.watchOut: Хибний друг! Cheque — банківський чек, яким платять. Чек з магазину — receipt. Американською cheque пишуть check.

items.pattern: pay by credit card / debit card
items.meaning: plastic cards for paying: with a debit card the money comes from your bank account at once; with a credit card you pay the bank later
items.example: Mum paid for the new fridge with her **credit card**.
more: My **debit card** takes the money straight from my bank account.
Can I pay with my **debit card**?
items.watchOut: Звичайна банківська картка, на якій твої гроші, — debit card. Платити карткою — pay by card або pay with a card.

items.pattern: pay (in) cash · some cash
items.meaning: money in coins and notes (not a card)
items.example: We need **cash** for the school fair. They don't take cards.
more: Is there a **cash** machine near here?
I always carry a little **cash** for the bus.
items.watchOut: Cash — незлічуване: some cash, не a cash / cashes. Готівкою — in cash або просто cash: I paid cash.

items.meaning: a piece of paper money
items.example: Mum gave me a five-pound **note** to buy lunch.
more: The machine doesn't take **notes**, only coins.
There's a picture of a famous person on every **note**.
items.watchOut: Купюра — note (у США — bill). Note також означає «записка»: I left a note on the fridge.

items.pattern: some change · small change · Here's your change.
items.meaning: coins or small notes; also the money you get back when you give too much
items.example: Have you got any **change**? I need a pound for the shopping trolley.
more: The shop assistant gave me the wrong **change**: one pound too little.
I keep my **change** in a small purse.
items.watchOut: Дрібні гроші і решта — обидва change, і воно незлічуване (не changes). «Решти не треба» — Keep the change.

items.pattern: a receipt · Can I have a receipt?
items.meaning: a piece of paper that shows what you bought and how much you paid
items.example: The shop assistant put the **receipt** in my bag.
more: Mum keeps all her **receipts** in a box.
I always check the **receipt** after I go shopping.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /rɪˈsiːt/, p не читається. Чек з магазину — receipt, не cheque.

items.pattern: a carrier bag · a plastic / paper bag
items.meaning: a plastic or paper bag from a shop to carry the things you buy
items.example: I always take my own **carrier bag** to the supermarket.
more: The **bag** broke and the oranges rolled everywhere.
Paper **bags** are better for nature than plastic ones.
items.watchOut: Пакет у магазині — a (carrier) bag, не a packet. Packet — це пачка: a packet of crisps, a packet of tea.

warmup.explain: Чек з магазину — receipt (p не читається). Cheque — банківський чек, яким платять; note — банкнота.
Пакет у магазині — a (carrier) bag. Packet — пачка, package — посилка.

warmup.uk: Кафе на першому поверсі (на рівні вулиці), біля входу.
warmup.q: The café is on the ___, near the entrance.
warmup.explain: У Британії поверх на рівні вулиці — ground floor. First floor — це вже наш другий поверх.
Приміряти — try on. З it слово стоїть посередині: try it on.

warmup.q: I need to go to the ___.
warmup.explain: Аптека — the chemist's (або pharmacy). Chemistry — хімія, а medicine shop так не кажуть.
Відчинений — open (прикметник). Opened — дія: хтось відчинив.
Після does дієслово без -s: How much does it cost? Price — іменник «ціна».
Готівкою — in cash. Cash незлічуване, тому без -es.

A.q: You can buy bread and cakes at the ___.
A.explain: Хліб і тістечка — у the baker's. Butcher's — м'ясо, newsagent's — газети й журнали.

A.q: Grandma wants to send a letter. She's going to the ___.
A.explain: Листи й посилки надсилають на пошті — the post office.

A.q: A ___ is a very big shop with many floors and lots of different things.
A.explain: Великий магазин на кілька поверхів — department store (універмаг).

B.q: In a British shop, the floor at street level is the ___.
B.explain: Ground floor — на рівні вулиці. First floor — поверхом вище, basement — під землею.

B.q: My room has very little ___: just a bed and a chair.
B.explain: Ліжко, стілець, стіл — це furniture (меблі), незлічуване слово.
Техніка, що працює від електрики, — electricals.

C.explain: Push — від себе, pull — до себе.

C.q: It's eight in the evening and you can't go into the shop. It's ___.
C.explain: Зачинено — closed, з -d. Close без -d тут означає «близько».

C.q: You pay for your things at the ___.
C.explain: Платять на касі — at the cash desk.

D.q: The shop assistant gave me a ___ with the price and the date on it.
D.explain: Папірець з ціною і датою — receipt (чек). Cheque — банківський чек, note — купюра.

D.q: My little sister's coat is too long. She needs a ___ size.
D.explain: Якщо річ завелика, потрібен a smaller size. More small — так не кажуть.

D.q: Before you buy the shoes, ___ them on.
D.explain: Приміряти — try on: try them on.

example.title: Shopping with Grandma
example.uk:
У суботу ми з бабусею пішли в універмаг. У дитячому відділі продавчиня запитала: «Вам допомогти?» Я знайшла синю куртку й приміряла її. Вона була замала, тож я попросила більший розмір.

Нова підійшла ідеально. «Скільки вона коштує?» — запитала бабуся. Ціна була двадцять п'ять фунтів. Бабуся заплатила готівкою, і продавчиня дала їй решту й чек.

Потім ми пішли в пекарню і купили два тістечка.
example.en:
On Saturday I went to the [[department store|a6]] with Grandma. In the [[children's department|b6]], a [[shop assistant|d1]] asked, '[[Can I help you?|d3]]' I found a blue jacket and [[tried it on|d4]]. It was too small, so I asked for a [[bigger size|d5]].

The new one was perfect. 'How much does it [[cost|d8]]?' Grandma asked. It was £25. Grandma paid in [[cash|d12]], and the shop assistant gave her the [[change|d14]] and the [[receipt|d15]].

Then we went to the [[baker's|a5]] and bought two cakes.
